evidence_contract.path_policy: Every path/sha256 record identifies an existing regular file beneath --evidence-root; paths are relative POSIX with no dot segments or symlink escape. All nested source/workflow paths are relative to the report output root.
evidence_contract.identity_policy: Implementation is exact {name,version,source_code_sha256} over current ontokin/*.py. Test/spec/tool inventory is current exact bytes. All SHA-256 records use sha256: plus lowercase hex unless an existing exporter or core schema explicitly uses raw hex. Source bundles, raw files, program manifests, retrieved artifact bytes, GLB metadata, destination records, browser samples and captures must agree. Retained evidence never implies tools executed during this runner.
evidence_contract.workflow: {path,sha256} to ontokin.surface-agent-workflow/0.1 with exact requests/responses, snapshots, accepted history, artifact chunks and fixed checks.
evidence_contract.legacy: {core:{path,sha256},agent:{path,sha256},construction:{path,sha256},construction_external:{path,sha256},full_suite:{path,sha256}}. Current C01-C20 and independently verified current C20 are mandatory, not the historical compatibility guard.
evidence_contract.full_suite_policy: Generated by run_full_suite()/--full-suite-only. Expected IDs exactly equal current unittest discovery. Every distinct method executes once and passes; loader errors, fixture errors, skipped or not-run tests, extra/duplicate results, and changed runtime/inventory keep the gate pending.
evidence_contract.ci_policy: Require one identified completed successful GitHub run at implementation_commit and unique successful Python 3.11, 3.12, 3.13 jobs plus a visual job. Head SHA is 40 lowercase hex; workflow URL is the actual Omegapy/OntoKin run URL. Each job run_id matches. Implementation and inventory match current package/tests/specs/tools. These are retained raw run/job attestations, not a live GitHub query. The identified commit must be locally readable: git ls-tree blobs must match every current runtime/test/spec/tool/workflow inventory byte, independently of the claimed SHA-256 labels.
evidence_contract.missing_policy: Absent, stale, contradictory or incomplete mandatory external evidence is pending. Executed unittest failure is failed. No case passes from a reported count, a schema-only check, an authored acceptance status, or a historical report belonging to different bytes.

non_claims: This gate addresses the bounded adopted M01-M12 milestone, not the complete programming language defined by GOAL.md.
Unselected adopted cases remain pending; full_gate_complete is false for subsets.
No arbitrary curved-surface approximation, rendering, physical mesh collision, textures or all-time motion bound is inferred.
regression_floor_basis: 439 distinct tests present after Agent/0.3 integration dependencies at 704d8da; includes all inherited legacy cases. This fixed ID floor is checked in addition to complete current discovery, never inferred from a count.
